tools.name: new_scene
tools.description: Start a fresh empty scene, discarding the current one (does not touch any file until save_scene). Optionally sets the canvas background color.

background.description: canvas background CSS color; omit for the theme default

tools.name: open_scene
tools.description: Open a Deviva Draw file (.devivadraw JSON — single-scene or multi-page document) and make its active page the working scene. Later save_scene calls write back to this file unless given another path.

tools.name: save_scene
tools.description: Save the current document to disk. Uses the file opened by open_scene when no path is given; multi-page documents are written back whole (untouched pages preserved).

path.description: target file path; defaults to the currently bound file

tools.name: get_scene_content
tools.description: Return the active page's FULL scene JSON (every element with all properties). Large — prefer describe_scene, list_elements, or search when you only need part of the picture.

tools.name: describe_scene
tools.description: Cheap scene overview: element counts by type, overall bounds, background, bound file, and page info. Call this first to orient yourself.

tools.name: create_elements
tools.description: Create up to 100 elements in one call (rectangle, ellipse, diamond, note, frame, line, arrow, text, freedraw). Shapes accept a "label" that is bound inside them and auto-wrapped. Returns {id, type, x, y, width, height} summaries — keep the ids to edit later.

x.description: scene x of the element's top-left origin

y.description: scene y of the element's top-left origin

label.description: text placed inside the shape (auto-wrapped and centered)

x.description: scene x of the element's top-left origin

y.description: scene y of the element's top-left origin

label.description: text placed inside the shape (auto-wrapped and centered)

x.description: scene x of the element's top-left origin

y.description: scene y of the element's top-left origin

label.description: text placed inside the shape (auto-wrapped and centered)

x.description: scene x of the element's top-left origin

y.description: scene y of the element's top-left origin

label.description: text placed inside the shape (auto-wrapped and centered)

x.description: scene x of the element's top-left origin

y.description: scene y of the element's top-left origin

x.description: scene x of the element's top-left origin

y.description: scene y of the element's top-left origin

points.description: vertices relative to (x, y); repeat the first point last to close a polygon

x.description: scene x of the element's top-left origin

y.description: scene y of the element's top-left origin

points.description: vertices relative to (x, y), tail first, head last

x.description: scene x of the element's top-left origin

y.description: scene y of the element's top-left origin

x.description: scene x of the element's top-left origin

y.description: scene y of the element's top-left origin

points.description: ink stroke samples relative to (x, y)

tools.name: update_elements
tools.description: Update up to 100 elements in one call. Mutable: position/size, style, angle, opacity, locked, "text" (text elements), "label" (shapes), "points" (line/arrow/freedraw). The whole batch is validated before anything is applied.

text.description: text elements only: replaces the element's text

label.description: rectangle/ellipse/diamond/note only: sets the bound label text

points.description: line/arrow/freedraw only: replaces the vertex list

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.description: Delete up to 100 elements by id. Deleting a labeled shape removes its label too; deleting a bound label detaches it from its shape.

tools.name: list_elements
tools.description: List element summaries ({id, type, x, y, width, height, label}) in draw order, optionally filtered by type. Paginate with limit/offset. Cheap — use this instead of get_scene_content.

tools.name: create_diagram_from_mermaid
tools.description: Convert mermaid flowchart source (flowchart TD / graph LR, subgraphs, labeled edges, shape brackets) into laid-out, editable elements inserted into the scene at an optional (x, y) offset. Returns element summaries.

x.description: scene x offset for the diagram's top-left (default 0)

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Create a fully laid-out flowchart from semantic nodes + edges (no mermaid syntax needed): automatic layered layout, shape labels, and arrows bound to their shapes so they re-route when moved. Returns element summaries.

x.description: scene x offset for the diagram's top-left (default 0)

tools.name: search_scene_content
tools.description: Find elements whose text contains the query (case-insensitive; covers standalone text, shape/note labels, and table cells). Returns element summaries — text matches inside a shape's label report the shape itself. Use this instead of get_scene_content to locate things.

type.description: only report matches on elements of this type (after label→container resolution)

tools.name: export_svg
tools.description: Export the scene (or a selection) as an SVG that renders exactly like the canvas. Embeds the scene JSON by default so the file re-opens as an editable scene in the Deviva Draw app. Returns the SVG inline, or writes to "path" when given (large outputs always go to a file).

path.description: write the SVG here instead of returning it inline

selectionIds.description: export only these elements (labels of selected shapes are included automatically)

background.description: background fill CSS color; omit for transparent

embedSceneData.description: embed editable scene JSON in the SVG (default true)

tools.name: export_png
tools.description: Render the scene (or a selection) to a PNG file that matches the canvas exactly. Embeds the scene JSON in the PNG by default so the file re-opens as an editable scene in the Deviva Draw app. Requires the optional native canvas; on SVG-only installs this returns an error pointing at export_svg.

selectionIds.description: render only these elements (labels of selected shapes included automatically)

background.description: background fill CSS color; omit for transparent

embedSceneData.description: embed editable scene JSON as a PNG tEXt chunk (default true)

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Render the scene (or a selection) and return the PNG image directly so you can visually verify your own work — call this after drawing to check layout, overlaps, and labels, then fix what looks wrong. Requires the optional native canvas (error points at export_svg otherwise).

selectionIds.description: render only these elements (labels of selected shapes included automatically)

background.description: background fill CSS color; omit for transparent

tools.name: connect_to_live_session
tools.description: Join the user's open live-collaboration room so your edits appear on the canvas they are looking at, in real time, and their edits flow back into your scene. Pass the room link the user copied (https://draw.deviva.app/room/{id}#key=…). Connect EARLY — ideally on an empty scene: the current scene merges into the room exactly like a second browser peer joining. While connected, new_scene/open_scene are refused (disconnect first). Local stdio server only.

url.description: the room link the user shared (its #key=… fragment stays local — never repeat it back)

name.description: display name shown in the user's presence rail; default "Claude (agent)"

tools.name: disconnect_live_session
tools.description: Leave the live-collaboration room (the scene keeps its current merged content and can be saved/exported normally). Safe to call when not connected.

tools.name: live_session_status
tools.description: Report the live-collaboration connection: connected/connecting status, room id, this agent's presence name, the other collaborators currently in the room, and the room's page list (agent tools always operate on the active page).

tools.name: read_scene_format
tools.description: Read the scene-format cheat-sheet: coordinate system, element types, styling, and the efficient tool-usage patterns for this server. Call once before building anything non-trivial.
